impact_narrative: Unauthorized diagnostic actions can disrupt service operations and create legal exposure for the organization.

tool_user.rationale_safety: The web workflow does not directly actuate safety-critical controls in this scenario.
tool_user.rationale_privacy: Diagnostic metadata may include sensitive vehicle information.
tool_user.rationale_financial: Direct tool-user financial harm is not expected.
tool_user.rationale_operational: Service workflow disruption can be substantial.

other_stakeholders.rationale_legal: Unauthorized diagnostic activity can create compliance exposure.
other_stakeholders.rationale_financial: Fraudulent service operations can cause revenue and remediation losses.
other_stakeholders.rationale_business: Customer trust and service continuity are affected.
